name: Rail Mounted Gantry Crane
description: Safe Build Engineering's Rail Mounted Gantry Crane is a high performance crane engineered for port and rail terminal yard stacking operations. Featuring an anti-sway system with eight rope reeving, regenerative operation, electricity driven steering and full automation capability for maximum throughput with minimum energy consumption.
features: Rail span up to 50 m and lifting height up to 25 m
Available in cantilever and non-cantilever option
Anti-Sway System with Eight Rope Reeving
